figures.claim: Flex the knee to about ninety degrees with the foot on the couch and sit on the foot to hold it, as for an anterior drawer.
Rotate the tibia externally by about fifteen degrees, so the medial side is presented forwards.
A knee with valgus laxity at thirty degrees and no rotational component has an isolated superficial ligament injury, and this test is what separates the two.
The expected points are the ninety degree position, the fifteen degrees of external rotation, drawing the tibia forward, watching the medial plateau, and comparing with the neutral drawer.
